#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const string BAD_CHARS = "VK";
const string TARGET_SEQ = "VKA";
const int INF = 1000000;

class C {
    istream& in;
    ostream& out;
    bool eofFlag = false;
    stringTokenizer tokenStream;

public:
    C(istream& input, ostream& output) : in(input), out(output) {
        execute();
        // run(); // Uncomment if needed
    }

    void execute() {
        nextInt();
        string s = nextToken();
        out << fast(s) << "\n";
    }

    string sanitize(const string& s) {
        string sb;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (BAD_CHARS.find(c) != string::npos) {
                sb += c;
            } else {
                sb += 'A';
            }
        }
        return sb;
    }

    int slowMethod(string s) {
        s = sanitize(s);
        unordered_map<string, int> visitedMap;
        deque<string> queue;
        queue.push_back(s);
        visitedMap[s] = 0;

        while (true) {
            string currentStr = queue.front();
            queue.pop_front();
            int dist = visitedMap[currentStr];
            if (currentStr.find_first_of(BAD_CHARS) == string::npos) {
                return dist;
            }
            for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < currentStr.size(); i++) {
                string swapped = swapChars(currentStr, i, i + 1);
                if (!swapped.empty() && visitedMap.find(swapped) == visitedMap.end()) {
                    visitedMap[swapped] = dist + 1;
                    queue.push_back(swapped);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    string swapChars(const string& s, int i, int j) {
        if (s[i] == s[j]) return "";
        string arr = s;
        std::swap(arr[i], arr[j]);
        return arr;
    }

    int fast(const string& s) {
        string s_sanitized = sanitize(s);
        int len = (int)s_sanitized.size();
        vector<int> indices(len);
        vector<vector<int>> positions(3);
        vector<int> sizes(3, 0);

        vector<vector<vector<int>>> countHere(3, vector<vector<int>>(len, vector<int>(3, 0)));
        vector<vector<int>> prefixSum(len + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));
        prefixSum[0] = {0, 0, 0};

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            int cIdx = (int)TARGET_SEQ.find(s_sanitized[i]);
            indices[i] = cIdx;
            if (i > 0) {
                prefixSum[i + 1] = prefixSum[i];
            }
            prefixSum[i + 1][cIdx]++;
            positions[cIdx].push_back(i);
            sizes[cIdx]++;
            countHere[cIdx][sizes[cIdx] - 1] = prefixSum[i + 1];
        }

        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(2, vector<vector<vector<int>>>(sizes[0] + 1, vector<vector<int>>(sizes[1] + 1, vector<int>(sizes[2] + 1, INF))));
        int minCost = INF;
        dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

        for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sizes[0]; j0++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sizes[1]; j1++) {
                for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= sizes[2]; j2++) {
                    for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                        int totalIdx = j0 + j1 + j2;
                        int current = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
                        if (current == INF) continue;
                        if (totalIdx == len) {
                            minCost = std::min(minCost, current);
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (j0 < sizes[0]) {
                            int cost = std::max(j1 - countHere[0][j0][1], 0) + std::max(j2 - countHere[0][j0][2], 0);
                            dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2] = std::min(dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2], current + cost);
                        }
                        if (j1 < sizes[1] && last == 0) {
                            int cost = std::max(j0 - countHere[1][j1][0], 0) + std::max(j2 - countHere[1][j1][2], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2], current + cost);
                        }
                        if (j2 < sizes[2]) {
                            int cost = std::max(j0 - countHere[2][j2][0], 0) + std::max(j1 - countHere[2][j2][1], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1], current + cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return minCost;
    }

    string generateSampleString() {
        static std::mt19937 rng(321);
        int n = 7;
        std::uniform_int_distribution<int> dist(0, 2);
        std::string buf(n, 'A');
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            buf[i] = TARGET_SEQ[dist(rng)];
        }
        return buf;
    }

    void run() {
        static std::mt19937 rng(321);
        for (int t = 0;; t++) {
            string s = generateSampleString();
            int fastRes = fast(s);
            int slowRes = slowMethod(s);
            if (fastRes != slowRes) {
                cerr << "Mismatch on: " << s << "\n";
                cerr << "Fast: " << fastRes << "\n";
                cerr << "Slow: " << slowRes << "\n";
                throw std::runtime_error("Mismatch detected");
            }
            cerr << "Iteration: " << t << "\n";
        }
    }

    string nextToken() {
        while (tokenStream.empty()) {
            string line;
            if (!getline(in, line)) {
                eofFlag = true;
                return "";
            }
            std::istringstream iss(line);
            tokenStream = stringTokenizer(iss);
        }
        string token = tokenStream.next();
        return token;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return std::stoi(nextToken());
    }

private:
    class stringTokenizer {
        std::istringstream iss;
    public:
        stringTokenizer() {}
        stringTokenizer(std::istringstream& s) : iss(s) {}
        bool hasMoreTokens() {
            return !iss.eof();
        }
        std::string next() {
            std::string token;
            iss >> token;
            return token;
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    C c(std::cin, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
